supported: Cluster.drawU resolves group.getPackageStyle(), falling back to skinParam.packageStyle(), then constructs ClusterDecoration(packageStyle, group.getUSymbol(), ...). ClusterDecoration.guess returns the non-null explicit symbol before PackageStyle.toUSymbol().

Cluster.getStyle uses USymbols.PACKAGE when group.getUSymbol() is null, so global packageStyle changes decoration geometry without promoting ordinary package paint/style lookup to the fallback symbol.
PackageStyle.fromString accepts rectangle and rect, and PackageStyle.toUSymbol maps rectangle, node, database, frame, cloud, and folder to their corresponding symbols.
No reference to this mechanism name, any checker input name, a held-out path, or golden fixture text was found in shipping crates. The mechanism diff passes git diff --check.
disproven: The Rust title-layout path calls effective_package_kind for every cluster. This applies DATABASE_CLUSTER_TITLE_EXTRA and NODE_CLUSTER_TITLE_WIDTH_EXTRA/NODE_CLUSTER_TITLE_HEIGHT_EXTRA to global fallback styles, although Java's ClusterHeader is created from the group's explicit symbol before ClusterDecoration performs packageStyle fallback.

EntityImageEmptyPackage directly calls new ClusterDecoration(getSkinParam().packageStyle(), null, ...). A valid ordinary empty package therefore does receive the packageStyle symbol in Java. Rust layout_empty_packages keeps symbol_kind at automatic_package_kind(package), so global fallback is omitted for that leaf path.

The Rust result for the explicit-keyword matrix is a DESCRIPTION diagram rather than Java's CLASS diagram, so node/frame/cloud keyword clusters do not retain explicit-symbol precedence in the product path.

findings.summary: Global node and database fallback is incorrectly coupled to explicit-symbol title sizing.
findings.evidence: effective_package_kind drives the ClusterHeader title-size extras in Rust. The node controls fail in both TB and LR with an added 60px width and/or 5px height, while the database controls fail in both top-level and nested forms with a 15px-per-cluster vertical displacement. Java resolves packageStyle only when ClusterDecoration chooses its asBig symbol after ClusterHeader is already built.

findings.summary: The account's empty-package exclusion is false for valid empty package groups.
findings.evidence: Java EntityImageEmptyPackage constructs ClusterDecoration(getSkinParam().packageStyle(), null, ...), and checker_empty_control_valid_tb renders an empty ordinary package as a cloud. Rust layout_empty_packages does not consult configured_package_kind for symbol_kind, so it renders the same leaf with ordinary folder chrome.

findings.summary: Explicit keyword precedence is not preserved across the requested keyword forms.
findings.evidence: checker_explicit_precedence_lr is valid Java class-diagram input containing node, frame, and cloud clusters. Java produces all five CLASS clusters, but Rust produces a DESCRIPTION diagram with 52 elements against Java's 70. This prevents accepting the claim that a global fallback cannot replace explicit keyword symbols.
